serverInfo.title: NSW Development Applications (x402)
serverInfo.description: NSW development application data for AI agents: search by council/suburb/postcode, nearby applications within 2 km, full application detail, and one-call property planning reports (zoning, height, FSR, lot size, heritage). Free summary tool; paid tools charge per call via x402 (USDC on Base). Data from the NSW Planning Portal (CC BY 4.0), synced several times a day.
